chars.WIFE: BOSS'S WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late forties, kind round face, wearing a burgundy velvet house djellaba with gold trim and a cream headscarf tied loosely
chars.SAFOUANE: YOUNG WORKER: a thin Moroccan young man of 19, short black curly hair, wearing a faded mustard-yellow hoodie with aluminium dust, dark grey work trousers
chars.BOSS: BOSS: a heavy Moroccan man in his fifties, bald with a thick grey moustache, wearing a dark green short-sleeve shirt with a pen in the pocket and brown trousers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the street outside a Moroccan house door in Mohammedia, head-to-waist: WIFE stands in the open doorway handing a covered aluminium lunch pot toward the viewer, leaning forward with a curious, searching look on her face, as if about to ask a question. Midday light, tiled entrance behind her. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At the house doorway, WIFE looks at SAFOUANE with warm motherly sympathy, hand on her chest, while he holds the lunch pot shyly, eyes down. Moroccan house entrance with green tiles. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of WIFE shaking her head with a sad knowing smile, raising one hand as if saying 'be patient with him, poor boy'. Moroccan entrance hall behind her. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: WIFE holds the lunch pot back for a moment and leans close to SAFOUANE, eyes narrowed, whispering a question; SAFOUANE freezes, surprised and uneasy. Doorway of a Moroccan house at midday. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SAFOUANE forces a nervous smile and nods, sweat on his forehead, telling a lie; WIFE watches him carefully with folded arms, not fully convinced. Moroccan house doorway. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small aluminium workshop with window frames and profiles on the walls, BOSS points his finger at SAFOUANE's chest, giving strict secret instructions with a sly look; SAFOUANE listens, holding a broom, intimidated. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: SAFOUANE alone sweeping aluminium shavings off the floor of the small workshop, tired and fed up, late afternoon sun through the open shutter. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: SAFOUANE pulling down the metal rolling shutter of the aluminium workshop on a quiet Moroccan street at 5 pm, looking over his shoulder suspiciously down the street. Vertical 2D animated illustration, no text.
